inn.crystal.welcome: Welcome! A night's stay is 200 yen. Would you like to stay with us?
inn.crystal.declined: Is that sooo? Well then, whenever you want to rest again, please come stay at our hotel!
inn.crystal.pay_first: Ummm, our hotel is pay-in-advance, you seeee. We need you to pay first.
inn.crystal.sorry: Ahh, I'm so terribly sorryyy. Please come again some other time!
inn.crystal.room: Understooood. Here's your room key. Your room is number {room}. Enjoy your stay!
inn.crystal.nice_room: Hmm. Pretty nice. It's big. It's got a bed. Only 200 yen for this? That's cheap. Wait, is the yen in this game different from real yen? I dunnooo.
inn.crystal.bath: So this is the bath. It's huge.
inn.crystal.bath_alone: Oh? I've got it all to myself! Woo-hoo!
inn.crystal.bath_good: What a nice bath! Feels sooo good. Time to wash up. Wait, you're supposed to wash before you get in, right? Ahahaha!
inn.crystal.bath_basin: Oops, I dropped the wash basin.
inn.crystal.beaten: So there's a bath here and stuff. Might be nice to go check it out. I did get beaten to a pulp by {enemy}, after all.
inn.crystal.hammer: Is that a bath over there? Let's go see.
But first, maybe I'll swing my hammer around for fun.
inn.door_stuck: Dang it! Why won't it open?!
inn.key_card: Oh, I have to stick the key card in here. Click!
inn.opened: It opened. Okay, time for bed.
inn.bored: Nothing to do. What should I dooo?
inn.dream: Huh, wha? W-was it a dream...? Ahh, that was so scaryyy.
inn.crystal.morning: Good morniiing! Take care out there today!
inn.arkhaia.welcome: Welcome. It's 700 yen for the night. Want to stay?
inn.arkhaia.declined: I see. If you want to rest again, come by anytime.
inn.arkhaia.pay_first: Sorry, but I can't let you stay without paying.
inn.arkhaia.sorry: Too bad. Come again sometime, okay?
inn.arkhaia.room: Understood. Your room is number {room}, so get some good rest.
inn.arkhaia.nice_room: Ah, the Arkhaia City hotel really is something else. Just what you'd expect from a fancy inn. Though when I see them selling a Bronze Knife for 10000 yen, I just wanna yell, why does a knife cost that much?!
inn.arkhaia.dog: Traveler: Cute, isn't he? His name's Jade.

Traveler: He was starving when I found him on my travels, so I brought him along. He sniffs out bombs and stuff, so he's a huge help. He also digs up Sabon fruit that got buried in the ground. Hahahaha!
{player}: That's amazing! Keep up the good work, Jade!
inn.arkhaia.arcade: Yaaawn. This feels so good. I wanna go to the arcade again.
inn.arkhaia.comfortable: This is so comfy. And apparently it has air conditioning and an internet cable, too.
inn.arkhaia.beaten: Phew. I'm so tired. Time to get some good rest. I did get beaten to a pulp by {enemy}, after all.
inn.arkhaia.hammer: Hmmm. Guess I'll swing my hammer around for fun.
inn.arkhaia.morning: It's morning! Do your best today!
